title: CFAL-bench MG benchmark harness and measurements — thesis snapshot
description:
Benchmark harness and raw measurement data for the Multigrid (MG) evaluation in the MSc thesis A Novel Type System for Rank-Polymorphic Array Languages (Radboud University, 2026).

Contains the SLURM job templates and scripts, and the raw per-run GFLOPS and compile-time records for classes A, B and C across the spec/inline variants, 20 runs per cell.

Licensing. This is a fork of diku-dk/CFAL-bench, which publishes no licence of its own. The ISC grant in the LICENSE file covers only the depositor's own contributions. Four files are inherited from upstream and remain under their authors' copyright, with no rights granted here: README.md, .gitmodules, MG/README.md and MG/sac/src/MG.sac. Anyone wishing to reuse those files should approach the upstream project.

The MG benchmark is described in van Balen et al., Comparing Parallel Functional Array Languages: Programming and Performance (arXiv:2505.08906). The compiler versions benchmarked are archived separately at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22060662.
